title: fix(types,console): retire the page kind jsx from PageNodeSchema.kind; the console sample moves to html (objectui#12464)
body:
Fixes #12464
Clause-②: yes — the published `@object-ui/types` `PageNodeSchema.kind` narrows (drops `'jsx'`), levelled `minor` (objectui levels a breaking change `minor`, never `major`)

The objectui layer of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23543 family F5-jsx, which landed in `@objectstack/spec` as objectstack-ai/objectstack#23638 (`c5dd7fce30`): spec 18 refuses the page kind `jsx` and names `html`.

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/types`, TS face.** `PageNodeSchema.kind` is `'full' | 'slotted' | 'html' | 'react'`; its docblock no longer calls `jsx` an accepted alias. The `@ts-expect-error` comment in `authoring-nodes-11364.test.ts` lists the four kinds.
- **`@object-ui/types`, zod face (premise correction).** The card measured "no `'jsx'` page kind in `packages/types/src/zod/`". That holds for the literal text, but the zod `PageNodeSchema` takes `kind` from the spec's `PageSchema` by reference, so on the pinned `18.0.0-next.1` it still admitted `jsx`. With the TS face narrowed, the zod face was wider than the TS face, and `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` failed `types` type-check with two TS2322 (`"layout.zod.ts#PageNodeSchema"` and `"kind"` not assignable to `never`, from `WiderLedgerMismatch` and `WiderLedgerKeyDrift`). The zod face now picks its enum out of the spec's by reference, `stripImportedDefaults(SpecPageSchema).shape.kind.unwrap().extract(['full', 'slotted', 'html', 'react'])`, the way `PAGE_KIND_NODE_TYPE` already does for `type`. Against spec `main` this is the spec's own enum. Against `next.1` it refuses `jsx` at `kind`. A kind the spec drops fails to compile here. A ledger entry was not used because it cannot be correct on both spec versions: it would be stale on spec `main`.
- **Console sample.** `apps/console/src/sdui-jsx-preview.tsx` authors `kind: 'html'`; its header comment names the html tier. The extraction pin in `sdui-preview-page-source-query-params.test.ts` reads `sdui-jsx-preview.tsx:command_center:html`.
- **`@object-ui/components` page renderer: the `'jsx'` arm stays (half 2 deferred, below).** Narrowing the type made the arm a compile error: `TS2367: This comparison appears to be unintentional because the types '"full" | "slotted" | undefined' and '"jsx"' have no overlap` (the components declaration build). The renderer now reads `kind` as the stored wire value, `const kind: string | undefined = schema.kind;`. That is a widening annotation, not a cast. Its comment says why: a server on a spec built before the retirement can serve a stored `jsx` row. No `jsx` to `html` mapping is added anywhere. Rendering is unchanged.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/guide/react-pages.md` no longer says `"jsx"` "is still accepted"; it says the alias was retired in spec 18 and to author `"html"`.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/12464-retire-page-kind-jsx.md`: `@object-ui/types: minor`, `@object-ui/console: patch` (the console is published: no `private` field). `@object-ui/components` gets no entry because its behaviour does not change.

## Half 2 (the renderer's `'jsx'` arm): deferred

The pin reading on this tree:
- `packages/types` and `packages/components` both resolve `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.1` from the lockfile and the installed store. Its `dist/ui/index.mjs` declares `kind: z.enum(["full", "slotted", "html", "react", "jsx"])` and `COMPILED_PAGE_KINDS = ["html", "jsx"]`.
- `npm view @objectstack/spec@next version` answers `18.0.0-next.1` (dist-tags `next: 18.0.0-next.1`, `latest: 17.7.0`). The published manifest carries no `gitHead`.

The resolved spec therefore does not carry `c5dd7fce30`, and the arm stays as the triage requires. The PM splits it into its own card. **Pin window:** until a `next` built from `c5dd7fce30` or a descendant is resolved, a stored `jsx` page served by a `next.1` runtime still renders as `html` through that arm.

## Verification (head `4cc23c7f7`)

- Closure build `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...' --concurrency=2`: 34/34 tasks.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`: exit 0 each.
- vitest, root form:
  - `packages/types/`: 383 files, 10335 tests passed.
  - 19 targeted files (the page renderer suites, the console preview and html-tier suites, `public-contract`, the app-shell `pageRequiresStamp` double): 220 tests passed.
- New pin `packages/types/src/__tests__/page-kind-jsx-retired-12464.test.ts`: `Equal` on the whole `kind` union, a `@ts-expect-error` on `kind: 'jsx'`, and a zod `safeParse` refused at path `kind` with `html` as the control.
- **Reverse verification** (after commit, with a trap restore): `'jsx'` was re-added to the TS union and to the `.extract` list. Then `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` reported `TS2344` (the `Equal` pin) and `TS2578` (the unused `@ts-expect-error`), and vitest reported `1 failed | 1 passed` (the zod pin). Restore proof: `git diff HEAD` was empty, and both files' hashes matched their HEAD blobs.
- eslint over the 7 changed source files: 0 errors and 10 warnings, every warning pre-existing (`no-explicit-any` and `exhaustive-deps` on untouched lines). The population is the config's `**/*.{ts,tsx}` block, and the file count comes from `--format json`. The config enables no type-aware linting (no `projectService` or `project`), so these edits cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.
- Exit 0 for each of `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes` and `new-line-citations`. Also exit 0: `check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` (792 of 792 blocks judged, after its scoped build), `check-changeset-fixed.mjs` and `check-changeset-presence.mjs`. The guard `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` reports NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED, Spec Main Shape Gate locally. Reason: it needs a spec tarball built from objectstack `main`, which was not built in this container. The check runs on this PR. By construction, on spec `main` the TS `kind` equals the spec's four-value enum, so the TS2430 at `PageNodeSchema` no longer applies, and the zod `.extract` is the identity there.
- NOT MEASURED, `check:spec-floors`. It exits 1 with `no-artifact` because it needs a whole-workspace build, and it is the known red on `main`.

## Acceptance notes (noted, not filed)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.pageRequiresStamp-11357.test.tsx`: the server double's `compiledRequires` reads `body.kind !== 'html' && body.kind !== 'jsx'`, mirroring `next.1`'s `COMPILED_PAGE_KINDS`. It is test-only and outside this card's file surface. Carrier: the half-2 card.
- `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts`: the comment on the re-attached spec checks names an `html` / `react` / `jsx` page, and `html` / `jsx` for `checkPageRequiresKind`. That describes `next.1`'s checks. Carrier: the half-2 card.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx`: the comment above `getJsxManifest` still reads "a `kind:'jsx'` page carries a constrained JSX `source`". Carrier: the half-2 card.
- The sample keeps its file name `sdui-jsx-preview.tsx` (with `sdui-jsx-preview.html`, and the names in two console tests) and its `page as any`. A rename touches files outside this card's surface. Carrier: none.
